concepts.learning_objective: Describe topographical maps as large-scale general purpose base maps prepared by the national mapping organisation.
Relate the scales of Survey of India topographical maps to their latitudinal and longitudinal coverage.

topics.title: Methods of relief representation and contours

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the methods used to show relief on maps, such as hachures, hill shading, layer tints, spot heights and contours.
Explain contour interval, horizontal equivalent and the basic features of contour lines.
Distinguish gentle, steep, concave and convex slopes from the spacing of contours.

topics.title: Landforms shown by contours
topics.ncert_sections: Types of Landform; Valley; Cliff; Waterfall and Rapids

concepts.learning_objective: Recognise conical hills, plateaus, cliffs and waterfalls from their contour patterns.
Distinguish V-shaped valleys, U-shaped valleys, gorges and spurs on a contour map.
Apply the steps for drawing a cross-section from contours using a suitable vertical scale.

topics.title: Cultural features and map interpretation
topics.ncert_sections: Identification of Cultural Features; Interpretation of Topographical Maps; Map Interpretation Procedure

concepts.learning_objective: Identify settlement types, sites and transport patterns shown on topographical sheets.
Interpret a topographical sheet under its standard heads and by superimposing feature maps.
